Thanks for reporting this. Video-React is in security-only maintenance until January 2028, and security reports are the one kind of issue we still handle.

Please report vulnerabilities privately as described in [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/video-react/video-react/blob/master/SECURITY.md), so a fix can ship before the details are public. If this issue includes exploit details, consider editing them out. A maintainer will review it.
